deep_analysis.radar_relevance: Provides a transferable evaluation design for participatory foresight, satisfying Strand B.

claims.qualification: The framework is adapted from existing participation/GESI literature and evaluated on 15 cases; it is a reusable assessment design, not a wholly new foresight technique.
claims.text: The authors adapt and apply a framework for evaluating gender and social inclusion across participatory scenario-guided foresight processes.
